unresolved_intent.rationale: SPEC says print exactly ERROR and the contract mandates exit 0 for all inputs; it does not specify a distinct error exit status, so success exit is kept uniform

unresolved_intent.rationale: An empty stream is not a JSON array; SPEC classifies non-array/invalid-JSON input as ERROR (AC-SM-06)

unresolved_intent.decision: Rely on json.loads strictness: trailing non-whitespace data after the array raises ValueError and becomes ERROR
unresolved_intent.rationale: SPEC treats invalid JSON as ERROR; json.loads rejects trailing garbage, matching the total-error stance without adding custom parsing
